claim_text: In tension along [0001] the crystal elongates ~45% at 65-80 MPa by kink-band formation, the first bulk demonstration of tensile ductility by kinking

steps.observation: Tensile [0001] test at RT: the flow stress starts at ~72 MPa, is serrated between ~52 and ~80 MPa, and the specimen reaches ~45% plastic strain before fracture
steps.image_note: the text quotes a ~55 MPa tensile yield stress, but no low-strain point of the plotted curve is near 55 MPa; the first plateau is ~65-72 MPa and 52 MPa is reached only at the ~17% serration

panels.caption_span: Stress-strain curve in the tensile test of Mg99.2Zn0.20.6 single crystal along [ooo1] at RT. The entire view of the deformed specimen is inserted in the figure The side surface planes in observation is parallel to (10i0)

steps.observation: The tensile gauge is filled with fine bands inclined to the [0001] tensile direction, across which the marked basal-plane trace kinks
steps.image_note: 100 um scale; the red basal-plane trace changes direction at each band, the same signature as the compression kink bands of Fig. 6

panels.caption_span: Higher magnification image of the deformation microstructure showing the formation of many deformation kink bands, observed at the part indicated by the red circle in Fig. 10

closing_why: the claim names a fact no panel carries: the 'first report of tensile ductility by kink-band formation in a bulk material' priority claim is text only
